verdict.rationale: Jan describes itself as an "open-source ChatGPT replacement" and "open-source replacement for Claude and ChatGPT." That loosely signals free use with no paid community/enterprise split, but the pack never names the license or states commercial-use terms. missing for 10: named license (e.g. Apache/AGPL), explicit statement on commercial/enterprise use, documentation of any paid tiers or subscriptions, independent corroboration.
